cause.what_happened: AIFA fell about 14.6% intraday after opening 1.2% higher, on 2.16x volume ($854k). That is its third heavy daily fall in a row after a 60-day run-up of +173%. The only dated company event was its virtual annual meeting at 10:00 ET today, voting on a 1,284,063-share increase to the equity plan and a 707,730-share issuance to President Yangyang Li, about 31% potential dilution against 6.42M shares outstanding. No press release, 8-K or news since 2026-09-30 ties either the meeting or anything else to the fall.

evidence.claim: The annual meeting was set for 2026-10-12 at 10:00 ET, virtual. Proposal 3 raises the equity plan from 627,218 to 1,911,281 shares (including a General Counsel award of up to 500,000 shares, 30% vesting at issuance). Proposal 4 issues 707,730 shares to Yangyang Li for his Knighted settlement guaranty and also needs Special Committee approval, which the proxy expects before 2026-10-31. Record-date shares outstanding: 6,420,316.

The latest issuer filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01. It says counsel for Primo Vital, a subsidiary of Ourgame, which went into Cayman official liquidation on 2026-03-03, disputes Jason Lu's claimed voting power over Primo's ~31.3% block. No newer filing exists as of the seal.
EDGAR full-text search for 'All In FutureTech' from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-12 returns only the 09-30 8-K and a third-party 13F. There is no 13D/A, Form 4 or new 8-K.

The last press release found was the 2026-10-04 inaugural annual conference release (AI education and content strategy, CES 2027 showcase). It carries no financials and no dated catalyst inside the window.

pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: Any of these filed tonight would change it: a 13D/A from Primo Vital or Ourgame's liquidators showing a sale out of the ~31% block, or the 5.07 8-K showing the dilutive proposals passed on a vote the disputed Primo block decided. The first is a dated seller (negative, or positive if the sale is complete); the second is a governance fight landing early.

outside_window.finding: The Item 5.07 8-K reporting the 2026-10-12 annual-meeting vote on the dilutive Proposals 3 (+1,284,063 plan shares) and 4 (707,730 shares to Yangyang Li) is due by 2026-10-16. The issuer's last meeting (2026-06-01) was reported on 2026-06-05, the fourth business day, so it most likely lands after the window. The proposals were public since 2026-09-14 and are partly priced.
The Special Committee must approve the 707,730-share issuance to Yangyang Li, with a fairness opinion, which the proxy expects before 2026-10-31. That is about 11% dilution once it completes.

Supply overhang: Primo Vital's ~31.3% block (11,986,523 pre-split shares, about 2.0M post 1:6) belongs to Ourgame, which has been in Cayman official liquidation since 2026-03-03, and control of the votes is disputed. Liquidators realise assets, and a +173% run in 60 days gives them a price to sell into. No filing shows any sale, and there is no date.
